gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue is an extra first-step dqds recurrence update that corrupts the k=1 pivot and stopping test. ISSUE-003 concerns a separate reconstruction-sign formula and does not diagnose the pivot recurrence or initialization.

The gold issue is a false chi-square tail bound used in the inverse-iteration probability proof. ISSUE-004 only challenges the numerical iteration-count algebra and supplies no diagnosis of the invalid probabilistic inequality or its replacement.

The gold issue is the missing guarantee that the approximate returned vector meets epsilon even when the exact subspace optimum does. ISSUE-004 addresses only an arithmetic undercount in the inverse-iteration loop and does not identify the exact-versus-approximate output contract gap.
